annotations.title: Hyperliquid large moves: one card per position, its steps, its distance to liquidation and the wallet's behaviour label

description: Call this when the user asks what Hyperliquid's largest traders just did, which large positions were opened, added to, cut, closed or flipped in the last 24 hours, how a large position got where it is, or how far it is from liquidation. Returns one card per position whose latest change is worth min_usd or more: the move (kind, time, dollars, size), the wallet's behaviour label (one_sided or two_sided, measured from its own readings, and new_wallet for a young account; an address is never given a name), the open position with its liquidation price and distance_to_liq_pct, or the estimated result once it ended, and the steps of the position so far; totals sum every move of the view, positions_total counts the cards. Stock, index and commodity contracts on the builder-deployed markets are included. Every key reads the moves of $10M and more on one-sided accounts, fresh and complete; moves from $1M, coin, side and accounts are part of Terminal and the plans above it (plan.capped says a filter was asked and not applied). A Free key reads this feed 30 minutes late (plan.delayed_minutes); the page bykaranteli.com/hyperliquid-whales/moves is not delayed. Without limit, the newest 12 cards; pass limit (up to 96) for more. Pass detail "compact" for a shorter page or "full" for the whole answer.

accounts.description: one_sided (default: accounts that hold a direction), new (young wallets) or all. Terminal and above.

coin.description: One coin as Hyperliquid names it, e.g. BTC, HYPE, xyz:NVDA (a builder-deployed market carries its dex in front; any case). Terminal and above.

detail.description: Optional. "compact": a shorter page than the default (fewer rows, newest points kept, rounded figures, long text cut, grids left out; every cut named in trimmed). "full" or true: the whole route answer, still under the 100,000 character ceiling (the largest boards answer the ceiling note then: narrow them with symbol, limit or days instead). Omitted or false: the default first page.

limit.description: Optional. Cards, newest first (default 12, up to 96).

min_usd.description: Optional. The size line: 1000000, 5000000, 10000000 or 30000000 (default 10000000 on a Free key, 1000000 on Terminal and above; below 10000000 on Terminal and above only).

side.description: long or short. Terminal and above.
